description: Na₂H₆TeSO₁₀ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent TeO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ pentagonal pyramid. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.56 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent TeO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one SO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 41-42°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.70 Å. There are six inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 1.00 Å. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 1.00 Å. In the third H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 1.00 Å. In the fourth H site, H is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.02 Å) and one longer (1.63 Å) H-O bond length. In the fifth H site, H is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.01 Å) and one longer (1.66 Å) H-O bond length. In the sixth H site, H is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.01 Å) and one longer (1.68 Å) H-O bond length. Te is bonded to six O atoms to form TeO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids and edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Te-O bond distances ranging from 1.93-1.97 Å. S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ pentagonal pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 52-65°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.48-1.52 Å. There are ten inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, one H, and one Te atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, one H, and one Te atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one S atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, one H, and one Te atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, one H, and one Te atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one H, and one Te atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one H, and one Te atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one H, and one S atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted tetrahedral geometry to one Na, two H, and one S atom.
